title: The free coffee QR on campus
scenario: A sticker on a campus café table says students get a free drink by scanning a QR code. The page asks for your university login and then prompts for an MFA approval.

answers.A: Approve the MFA prompt because the QR is physically inside the café.
answers.B: Do not log in; ask café staff whether the promotion and QR code are theirs.
answers.C: Navigate to the café/university promotion page independently if one exists.

explanation: Attackers can place stickers on real tables. Physical placement does not authenticate the digital destination.
proTip: Real café, fake sticker is still fake.
